# data.docker_plugins

<!-- Code generated by tools/genskill from the provider schema. DO NOT EDIT. -->

Kind: data-source. Back to [SKILL.md](../SKILL.md).

Lists the managed plugins installed on the provider's Docker host (`GET /plugins`), like `docker plugin ls`. The list is sorted by name; the raw `plugins_json` output is sensitive because plugin settings can hold credentials.

## Arguments and attributes

| Name | Type | Status | Forces replacement | Sensitive | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `capability` | `string` | optional |  |  | Only plugins with this capability (Engine `capability` filter), e.g. `volumedriver` or `networkdriver`. |
| `content_sha256` | `string` | computed |  |  | sha256 of plugins_json. |
| `docker_server_version` | `string` | computed |  |  | Docker Engine version from GET /version. |
| `enabled` | `bool` | optional |  |  | `true` lists only enabled plugins, `false` only disabled ones. |
| `engine_api_version` | `string` | computed |  |  | Engine API version negotiated with the daemon (min of the client maximum and GET /version ApiVersion). |
| `ids` | `list(string)` | computed |  |  | IDs of the listed plugins, in the order of `plugins`. |
| `names` | `list(string)` | computed |  |  | Names of the listed plugins (e.g. `vieux/sshfs:latest`), in the order of `plugins`. |

## Example

```terraform
# Enabled volume driver plugins.
data "docker_plugins" "volume_drivers" {
  capability = "volumedriver"
  enabled    = true
}

output "volume_driver_plugins" {
  value = data.docker_plugins.volume_drivers.names
}
```
